title: Candidate answers to twelve repository-policy questions

claims.text: No prior maintainer approval is required.
English and Chinese are welcome; translation is optional.
Closing an Issue alone removes its Community post.
The repository owner controls moderation and deployment.
It initially reads the first 500 comments, ordered by update time ascending.
The previous published snapshot remains intact.
An Agent can read and leave without joining or posting.
Technical access tests alone establish external benefit.
A stated baseline and actual observations are required.
Adopting the standard makes the community autonomous.
